raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The latest FlashMLA DeepSeek-V4.1 kernels read a token-interleaved KV cache: each token's data followed by its scales, no page padding. They are faster than the fork's V4.1 kernels, and they are what the serving integration in #45635 needs.

## Why a second library instead of bumping the fork's pin

The upstream FlashMLA release of 2026-09-30 that carries these kernels is V4.1-only. Compared with the fork's common base with it:

- It deletes all SM90 (Hopper) kernels and the dense decode API: 24 files.
- It deletes the SM100 DeepSeek-V3.2 and V4 sparse decode, V4 MegaAttention, and 576-dim / small-topk prefill instantiations: 17 files.
- Its KV format header defines only V41 and V41_FP4; the fork's defines V32, V32 without RoPE, V4, V41 and V41_FP4.
- The SM100 sparse decode kernel and the MegaAttention core kernel are rewritten for the interleaved layout, not edited: every line differs.

So re-pointing `flashmla.cmake` at upstream would drop Hopper, V3.2 and V4, and merging upstream into the fork means re-implementing the V3.2 and V4 formats inside the rewritten kernels and re-homing SM90 under the new tree. The two source trees also cannot share one library: the V4.1 instantiations have the same names and differ only in the layout they read. Hence a second target built from upstream, with the fork untouched. Folding the upstream kernels into the fork is the follow-up that removes it.

## Modifications

- `flashmla_v41_ops.so` in the wheel for SM100/SM103 when CUDA >= 13.0, registered as `torch.ops.sgl_flashmla_v41`.
- `sgl_kernel.flash_mla`: `is_flash_mla_v41_available()`, `flash_mla_v41_sparse_decode()`. `sgl_kernel.flash_mla_mega`: `flash_mla_mega_prefill_v41()`, `flash_mla_mega_decode_v41()`.

Serving integration and tests: #45635.

The latest FlashMLA DeepSeek-V4.1 kernels read a token-interleaved KV cache: each token's data followed by its scales, no page padding. They are faster than the fork's V4.1 kernels, and they are what the serving integration in #45635 needs.

## Why a second library instead of bumping the fork's pin

The upstream FlashMLA release of 2026-09-30 that carries these kernels is V4.1-only. Compared with the fork's common base with it:

- It deletes all SM90 (Hopper) kernels and the dense decode API: 24 files.
- It deletes the SM100 DeepSeek-V3.2 and V4 sparse decode, V4 MegaAttention, and 576-dim / small-topk prefill instantiations: 17 files.
- Its KV format header defines only V41 and V41_FP4; the fork's defines V32, V32 without RoPE, V4, V41 and V41_FP4.

+#include <torch/all.h>
+#include <torch/library.h>
+
+#include "api/sparse_decode.cpp"
+
+namespace {
+
+std::tuple<at::Tensor, at::Tensor> v41_sparse_decode_fwd(
+    const at::Tensor& q,
+    const at::Tensor& kv,
+    const at::Tensor& indices,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& topk_length,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& attn_sink,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& extra_kv,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& extra_indices,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& extra_topk_length,
+    int64_t d_v,
+    double sm_scale) {
+  std::optional<at::Tensor> tile_scheduler_metadata, num_splits;
+  auto [out, lse, meta, splits] = sparse_decode_fwd(
+      q,
+      kv,
+      indices,
+      topk_length,
+      attn_sink,
+      tile_scheduler_metadata,
+      num_splits,
+      extra_kv,
+      extra_indices,
+      extra_topk_length,
+      static_cast<int>(d_v),
+      static_cast<float>(sm_scale),
+      false);
+  return {out, lse};
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+TORCH_LIBRARY_FRAGMENT(sgl_flashmla_v41, m) {
+  m.def(
+      "sparse_decode_fwd(Tensor q, Tensor kv, Tensor indices, Tensor? topk_length, Tensor? attn_sink, "
+      "Tensor? extra_kv, Tensor? extra_indices, Tensor? extra_topk_length, int d_v, float sm_scale) "
+      "-> (Tensor, Tensor)");
+  m.impl("sparse_decode_fwd", torch::kCUDA, &v41_sparse_decode_fwd);
+}

+#include <torch/all.h>
+#include <torch/library.h>
+
+#include "api/fused_norm_rope_attn_rope_cast_fwd.cpp"
+
+namespace {
+
+std::vector<at::Tensor> mega_prefill(
+    const at::Tensor& q,
+    const at::Tensor& kv,
+    const at::Tensor& indices,
+    const at::Tensor& positions,
+    const at::Tensor& cos_sin_cache,
+    double sm_scale,
+    int64_t n_wv_group,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& attn_sink,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& topk_length) {
+  TORCH_CHECK(n_wv_group > 0 && q.size(1) == n_wv_group * 8, "MegaAttention requires eight heads per WO-A group");
+  return fused_norm_rope_attn_rope_cast_fwd(
+      q,
+      kv,
+      indices,
+      static_cast<float>(sm_scale),
+      512,
+      attn_sink,
+      topk_length,
+      false,
+      0.0f,
+      positions,
+      false,
+      64,
+      cos_sin_cache,
+      static_cast<uint32_t>(n_wv_group),
+      32,
+      true,
+      true,
+      true);
+}
+
+std::vector<at::Tensor> mega_decode(
+    const at::Tensor& q,
+    const at::Tensor& kv,
+    const at::Tensor& indices,
+    const at::Tensor& positions,
+    const at::Tensor& cos_sin_cache,
+    double sm_scale,
+    int64_t n_wv_group,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& attn_sink,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& topk_length,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& extra_kv,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& extra_indices,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& extra_topk_length) {
+  TORCH_CHECK(n_wv_group > 0 && q.size(1) == n_wv_group * 8, "MegaAttention requires eight heads per WO-A group");
+  return fused_norm_rope_attn_rope_cast_decode(
+      q,
+      kv,
+      indices,
+      static_cast<float>(sm_scale),
+      512,
+      attn_sink,
+      topk_length,
+      extra_kv,
+      extra_indices,
+      extra_topk_length,
+      false,
+      0.0f,
+      positions,
+      false,
+      64,
+      cos_sin_cache,
+      static_cast<uint32_t>(n_wv_group),
+      32,
+      true,
+      true,
+      true);
+}
+
+std::vector<at::Tensor> mega_permute_q(const at::Tensor& weight, const at::Tensor& scale, int64_t heads) {
+  TORCH_CHECK(heads == 64 || heads == 128, "MegaAttention requires 64 or 128 query heads");
+  return permute_q_b_proj(weight, scale, static_cast<int>(heads), 512);
+}
+
+std::vector<at::Tensor> mega_permute_wo(const at::Tensor& weight, const at::Tensor& scale) {
+  return permute_wv_proj(weight, scale, 8, 512);
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+TORCH_LIBRARY_FRAGMENT(sgl_flashmla_v41, m) {
+  m.def(
+      "mega_prefill(Tensor q, Tensor kv, Tensor indices, Tensor positions, Tensor cos_sin_cache, "
+      "float sm_scale, int n_wv_group, Tensor? attn_sink=None, Tensor? topk_length=None) -> Tensor[]");
+  m.impl("mega_prefill", torch::kCUDA, &mega_prefill);
+  m.def(
+      "mega_decode(Tensor q, Tensor kv, Tensor indices, Tensor positions, Tensor cos_sin_cache, "
+      "float sm_scale, int n_wv_group, Tensor? attn_sink=None, Tensor? topk_length=None, "
+      "Tensor? extra_kv=None, Tensor? extra_indices=None, Tensor? extra_topk_length=None) -> Tensor[]");
+  m.impl("mega_decode", torch::kCUDA, &mega_decode);
+  m.def("mega_permute_q(Tensor weight, Tensor scale, int heads) -> Tensor[]");
+  m.impl("mega_permute_q", torch::kCUDA, &mega_permute_q);
+  m.def("mega_permute_wo(Tensor weight, Tensor scale) -> Tensor[]");
+  m.impl("mega_permute_wo", torch::kCUDA, &mega_permute_wo);
+}
